chapterInfo.content:
36
Mma mmaa awarefoɔ ho asɛm
1 # Num 26.55; 27.6-7 Na Gilead, Makir ba, Manase ba mma abusuakuo mu mpanimfie so atitire a wɔfiri Yosef mma mmusua mu no ba bɛkasaa Mose ne mmapɔmma no, Israelfoɔ mpanimfie so atitire no, anim, 2na wɔse: AWURADE ahyɛ me wura sɛ wɔmfa ntontobɔ so nkyɛ asase no mu mma Israelfoɔ na wɔnni so, na me wura nyaa AWURADE anomu mmara sɛ wɔmfa yɛn nua Selofehad agyapadeɛ mma ne mmammaa. 3Na sɛ wɔkɔyɛ Israelfoɔ mmusuakuo mu mma bi yerenom a, ɛnneɛ wɔn agyapadeɛ no bɛfiri yɛn nananom agyapadeɛ mu, na wɔde akɔka abusuakuo ko a wɔakɔyɛ wɔn dea no agyapadeɛ ho, na afiri yɛn ntonto kyɛfa no mu; 4#Lew 25.10-13 na sɛ ɛduru Israelfoɔ ahosɛpɛ afahyɛ afe so a, wɔde wɔn agyapadeɛ no bɛka abusuakuo a wɔakɔyɛ wɔn dea no agyapadeɛ ho, na wɔayi wɔn agyapadeɛ afiri yɛn nananom abusuakuo agyapadeɛ mu.
5Na Mose nam AWURADE asɛm so hyɛɛ Israelfoɔ no sɛ: Deɛ Yosef mma abusuakuo aka yi tene. 6Yei ne deɛ AWURADE ahyɛ wɔ Selofehad mmammaa no ho: Obiara a wɔsusu sɛ ɔyɛ no, wɔnware no; nanso wɔn nananom abusuakuo mu abusua bi mu nko na wɔnwareɛ; 7na Israelfoɔ agyapadeɛ amfiri abusuakuo bi mu ankɔ abusuakuo foforɔ bi mu, na Israelfoɔ no mfemfam wɔn nananom abusuakuo agyapadeɛ ho. 8Na ɔbabaa biara a ɔnya agyapadeɛ Israelfoɔ mmusuakuo mu no nyɛ obi a ɔfiri n’agya abusuakuo mu abusua bi mu yerɛ, na Israelfoɔ no nnya wɔn nananom agyapadeɛ nni so, 9na agyapadeɛ bi amfiri abusuakuo bi mu ankɔ abusuakuo foforɔ mu; na Israelfoɔ mmusuakuo no mfemfam wɔn agyapadeɛ ho.
10Sɛdeɛ AWURADE hyɛɛ Mose no, saa ara na Selofehad mmammaa no yɛeɛ; 11#Num 26.33 na Mahla, Tirsa ne Hogla ne Milka ne Noa, Selofehad mmammaa no warewaree wɔn agya nuanom mma; 12na wɔwarewaree wɔn a wɔfiri Yosef ba Manase mma mmusua mu, na wɔn agyapadeɛ no kaa wɔn agya abusuakuo no mu.
13Yeinom ne mmara nsɛm ne atemmudeɛ a AWURADE nam Mose so hyɛɛ Israelfoɔ wɔ Moab mpaperɛ so Yordan fa a ɛbɛn Yeriko no.

Na Gilead, Makir ba, Manase ba mma abusuakuo mu mpanimfie so atitire a wɔfiri Yosef mma mmusua mu no ba bɛkasaa Mose ne mmapɔmma no, Israelfoɔ mpanimfie so atitire no, anim, na wɔse: AWURADE ahyɛ me wura sɛ wɔmfa ntontobɔ so nkyɛ asase no mu mma Israelfoɔ na wɔnni so, na me wura nyaa AWURADE anomu mmara sɛ wɔmfa yɛn nua Selofehad agyapadeɛ mma ne mmammaa. Na sɛ wɔkɔyɛ Israelfoɔ mmusuakuo mu mma bi yerenom a, ɛnneɛ wɔn agyapadeɛ no bɛfiri yɛn nananom agyapadeɛ mu, na wɔde akɔka abusuakuo ko a wɔakɔyɛ wɔn dea no agyapadeɛ ho, na afiri yɛn ntonto kyɛfa no mu; na sɛ ɛduru Israelfoɔ ahosɛpɛ afahyɛ afe so a, wɔde wɔn agyapadeɛ no bɛka abusuakuo a wɔakɔyɛ wɔn dea no agyapadeɛ ho, na wɔayi wɔn agyapadeɛ afiri yɛn nananom abusuakuo agyapadeɛ mu.
Na Mose nam AWURADE asɛm so hyɛɛ Israelfoɔ no sɛ: Deɛ Yosef mma abusuakuo aka yi tene. Yei ne deɛ AWURADE ahyɛ wɔ Selofehad mmammaa no ho: Obiara a wɔsusu sɛ ɔyɛ no, wɔnware no; nanso wɔn nananom abusuakuo mu abusua bi mu nko na wɔnwareɛ; na Israelfoɔ agyapadeɛ amfiri abusuakuo bi mu ankɔ abusuakuo foforɔ bi mu, na Israelfoɔ no mfemfam wɔn nananom abusuakuo agyapadeɛ ho. Na ɔbabaa biara a ɔnya agyapadeɛ Israelfoɔ mmusuakuo mu no nyɛ obi a ɔfiri n’agya abusuakuo mu abusua bi mu yerɛ, na Israelfoɔ no nnya wɔn nananom agyapadeɛ nni so, na agyapadeɛ bi amfiri abusuakuo bi mu ankɔ abusuakuo foforɔ mu; na Israelfoɔ mmusuakuo no mfemfam wɔn agyapadeɛ ho.
Sɛdeɛ AWURADE hyɛɛ Mose no, saa ara na Selofehad mmammaa no yɛeɛ; na Mahla, Tirsa ne Hogla ne Milka ne Noa, Selofehad mmammaa no warewaree wɔn agya nuanom mma; na wɔwarewaree wɔn a wɔfiri Yosef ba Manase mma mmusua mu, na wɔn agyapadeɛ no kaa wɔn agya abusuakuo no mu.
Yeinom ne mmara nsɛm ne atemmudeɛ a AWURADE nam Mose so hyɛɛ Israelfoɔ wɔ Moab mpaperɛ so Yordan fa a ɛbɛn Yeriko no.

app.t1_copy: I've bookmarked passages that are important to me. I've even read the whole thing through in a year thanks to the reading plans.
app.t2_copy: I love how you are able to connect with friends and the Bible reading plans are awesome. This application helps me also to stay consistent in reading because it has reminders for the plans. It also gives me another way to come closer to God. Download this and read every day!
app.t3_copy: Great app with a wide selection of Bibles to choose from. ... The audio Bibles are also wonderful and easy to understand.
app.t4_copy: Many translations and languages available, and many that can be downloaded to read offline. Many useful features, such as the ability to make notes and bookmarks.
app.t5_copy: I love how it has a lot of versions and that there are verses of the day, devotions, plans and community. Thanks for this free app. :)
app.t6_copy: Great because there are many different versions and I could download multiple versions for offline reading. I'm able to listen to this app.
app.t7_copy: Helps me to read the bible more. Love the search and share features and the variety of ways to share. Also like the audio versions.
app.t8_copy: This is a great tool for studying from multiple translations. It's also convenient for listening to the bible when you're driving.
app.t9_copy: This is the best bible app out there. It has the word in different languages and versions for online and offline use. It has devotionals for everything you could think of. You can connect with others and ultimately learn about God and his Word.
